title: Yellow Lacquered Korean Tofu Sujebi
description: A savory and romantic Korean dish from the Chungcheong region, featuring coriander leaves and a lacquer glaze, served in a molcajete vessel.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: lacquer glaze
ingredients.notes: made from turmeric and rice vinegar

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped coriander leaves and cook for another minute.
Add the tofu pieces and cook until they are lightly browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lacquer glaze, korean chili flakes, and salt.
Pour the glaze over the tofu and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the sujebi in a molcajete vessel.
Garnish with additional coriander leaves if desired.
